name: Bandit's Arm
effect: On Critical Hit: Target becomes Impaired until the end of their next turn.

name: Jinx
effect: The Croupier makes a tech attack against a character within Sensors. On a hit, until the end of the target's next turn, when they succeed on an attack, they must choose one: they take {3/4/5} explosive damage, or they reroll and keep the second result. This effect triggers only once per attack roll.

name: Fifty-Fifty
effect: The Croupier is Invisible until it takes damage. It regains Invisible at the start of the next round.

name: Stack the Odds
effect: The Croupier makes a tech attack against a character within Sensors. On a hit, until the end of the target's next turn, whenever they make an attack and the final result of their roll is odd, the attack does {3/4/5} less damage to its target. If the attack deals multiple damage types, this effect only applies to the highest damage value.

name: Loaded Die
effect:
Loaded Die (Size 1/2, HP {5/8/10}, Evasion {10/10/10}, E-Defense {10/10/10}, Tags: Drone)
The Croupier tosses a loaded die onto a free space within Sensors. Hostile characters within Burst 2 of the die suffer the effect of Jinx until they leave the area.

name: Big Blind
trigger: A character within Range 10 takes a free action or reaction.
effect: The Croupier interrupts the triggering character, attacking them with the Bandit's Arm.

name: Gambler's Fallacy
effect:
1/round, when a character within Sensors rolls an attack, check, or save, the Croupier may expend any number of charges from this system to add the same amount of Accuracy or Difficulty to the roll. The Croupier takes 2 heat for every charge spent.
The Croupier regains a charge every time it or an allied character within line of sight and Sensors fails an attack, check, or save.

name: The House Always Wins
effect: A character within Sensors must make a Systems save. On a failure, they emit a Burst 3 field of warped probability until the start of the Croupier's next turn. All attacks made by or against characters at least partially within the field cannot result in critical hits.

name: Fate Weave [Veteran]
effect: When the Croupier triggers a hostile character's reaction, they must make a Systems save. On a failure, the Croupier ignores all effects of their reaction.

name: Skeleton Key
effect: This weapon gains +1 Accuracy against targets that do not have cover.

name: Unlock Doors
effect:
The Gatekeeper opens two Line 3 gates in free spaces within Sensors but not necessarily line of sight. Each gate is 1 space tall and has a black side and a red side, clearly indicated to all characters on the field. Gates count as normal pieces of hard cover.
Whenever a character uses an ability that can target another character within line of sight and X spaces, if a gate is within their line of sight and X spaces, they can target any character within line of sight and X spaces of any other gate, as long as they and the target character are on the same color sides of their respective gates. For attacks, cover is determined from the gate within X spaces of the target. Reactions can also be triggered using the same rules. After each action or reaction that relies on a pair of gates, any Gatekeepers that opened either of the gates take 1 heat.
If there are more than two gates per Gatekeeper on the field, the oldest excess gates close immediately. The Gatekeeper may close any number of gates as a protocol or before taking this action again.

name: Eversion
effect: The Gatekeeper chooses any number of gates within Sensors and flips their orientations (i.e. the black side becomes red and vice versa).

name: Watchman
trigger: A character begins movement within Range 3 of any gate.
effect: The Gatekeeper may attack the triggering character with Overwatch as long as they are a valid target for one of its weapons, dealing half damage, burn, and heat.

name: Slam Shut
effect: The Gatekeeper chooses a gate within Sensors (but not necessarily line of sight) that was not opened this turn. It may use the Skeleton Key to attack a character within line of sight and Range 5 of that gate, then immediately closes it.

name: Summon
effect: The Gatekeeper teleports a character within Range 3 of a gate to a space within Range 3 of any other gate. The starting and ending spaces of the teleport must be on the same color sides of their respective gates. Hostile characters may avoid this effect by passing an Engineering save. The Gatekeeper may use this action on itself.

name: Close Sesame
trigger: A character makes a ranged or melee attack using a pair of gates.
effect: The Gatekeeper suspends part of the attack in space and time. The triggering attack deals half damage, burn, and heat, and the Gatekeeper gains the Open Sesame quick action until the end of its next turn. If the attacker is hostile, they may negate these effects by passing a Systems save.

name: Open Sesame
effect: The Gatekeeper releases the suspended attack. The original attacker must repeat the attack roll against a target of the Gatekeeper's choice within Range or Threat of any gate, dealing half damage, burn, and heat. Line of sight and cover are determined as if the gate were the origin of the attack.

name: Almighty Janitor [Veteran]
effect: 1/round, when the Gatekeeper is in the Danger Zone and uses the Skeleton Key to Skirmish, its attack becomes Line 8.

name: Black Thumb
effect:
If it is not Immobilized, the Hitchhiker can start a ride with an adjacent allied character as a quick action, designating them as the Driver for the duration of the ride. The Hitchhiker may also deploy already riding with any allied character.
During a ride, the Hitchhiker gains +4 Evasion to a maximum of 20, occupies the Driver's space, and is moved with the Driver whenever they move. The ride ends when the Hitchhiker would move away from the Driver or the Driver is destroyed. Before a ride ends, the Hitchhiker first moves into a free space of the triggering character's choice adjacent to the Driver.

name: "Blown Kiss" Pistol
effect: This weapon gains +1 Accuracy when used during a reaction.
on_hit: Target's next successful attack deals half damage, burn, and heat.

name: I'm Helping!
trigger: The Driver makes a successful attack roll.
effect: The Hitchhiker attacks the same target with the "Blown Kiss" Pistol.

name: Slow Down, Buckaroo
trigger: A character within Range 5 makes an attack roll that does not target the Hitchhiker.
effect: The Hitchhiker interrupts the triggering character, attacking them with the "Blown Kiss" Pistol.

name: That Was Too Close
trigger: Either the Hitchhiker or the Driver is targeted by a ranged attack.
effect: Before the triggering attack is rolled, the Hitchhiker makes an attack roll with the "Blown Kiss" Pistol. If the result is higher than the triggering attack roll, the triggering attack automatically misses. This reaction cannot be taken if it would cause the Hitchhiker to exceed its Heat Cap.

name: Go Get 'Em, Tiger
effect: The Driver gains the ability to Overcharge if they do not already have it. Instead of the standard cost, the Driver and all Hitchhikers riding with them take 1d3 heat.

name: On Your Six
effect: The Hitchhiker enters a state of hypervigilance. All of the Hitchhiker's and Driver's weapons gain +2 Threat until the start of the Hitchhiker's next turn. If the Hitchhiker's ride ends or it becomes Jammed, Exposed, or Stunned, this effect ends immediately.

name: This'll Patch Ya Up
effect: The Hitchhiker sprays a protective coating onto the Driver. The Driver gains +2 Armor up to a maximum of 4 until the end of the Hitchhiker's next turn or until the Hitchhiker's ride ends. The Hitchhiker cannot take this action again until its effect ends.

name: Get Dunked On!
effect:
A character within Sensors gains the Hitchhiker's Mark. Whenever they make an attack that does not include the Hitchhiker as a target, they must pass a Systems save afterwards or become Jammed until the end of their next turn. On a success, they become Impaired instead, but clear the Hitchhiker's Mark.
A character cannot be marked by more than one Hitchhiker at a time. The Hitchhiker can only mark one character at a time, but can transfer the Hitchhiker's Mark to another character by repeating this action.

name: My Lucky Day [Veteran]
effect: 1/round, during a ride, either the Hitchhiker or the Driver may roll an attack, check, or save twice and choose the higher result.

name: Will-O-Wisp
effect: The Lantern emits a Burst 3 area of flickering light. All attacks against hostile characters within this area gain +1 Accuracy, and whenever they critically hit, the Lantern may take 2 heat to deal {3/4/5} burn to the target.

name: Shadow Tag
effect:
The Lantern blazes brightly, designating a hostile character within line of sight and Sensors as the Gnomon until they end their turn outside the Lantern's line of sight or Sensors, or the Lantern uses this action again or is destroyed.
The Gnomon casts a Line 5 shadow that is as wide and tall as their Size and points directly away from the Lantern, updating its direction at the end of the Lantern's and the Gnomon's turns. If the Lantern is directly above or below the Gnomon, the Lantern may choose the shadow's direction.
The Lantern and allied characters may choose to treat the shadow as part of the Gnomon for any purpose. Additionally, the Gnomon makes all attacks, checks, and saves against the Lantern with +1 Difficulty.

name: Heat Wave
effect: The Lantern clears all heat. Hostile characters within Burst 2 must pass an Agility save or take {3/4/5} burn. If the Lantern takes this action in the Danger Zone, characters who fail also become Shredded until the end of their next turn. This action must be taken before the Lantern moves or takes any non-protocol action on its turn.

name: Levitate
effect: The Lantern can count any and all of its movement as flying. 1/round, when it would make a Hull check or save, it may roll with its Agility instead.

name: Mystical Fire
effect: Hostile characters affected by Will-O-Wisp cannot clear burn, and if they end their turn within the Burst 3 area they must pass an Agility save or take {3/4/5} burn.

name: Night Shade
effect: Hostile characters may not draw line of sight into or through spaces within, above, or below the Gnomon's shadow.

name: Glare
effect: The Lantern emits a blinding light. Until the start of its next turn, whenever a ranged or melee attack targets it or an allied character within Range 3, first roll 1d6. If the result is lower than half the Lantern's heat, the attack automatically misses.

name: Confuse Ray
effect: A character within Range 3 must make a Systems save. On a failure, until they end their turn outside Range 3 of the Lantern, they are Impaired and can only draw line of sight to adjacent spaces. Each character can only suffer this effect 1/scene.

name: Nightmare
effect: Until the end of the round, allied characters always have line of sight to characters affected by Will-O-Wisp and ignore cover, Invisible, and Hidden when targeting them. This action cannot be taken if it was already used in this round or the previous one.

name: Illuminate [Veteran]
effect: The final attack roll against any character affected by Will-O-Wisp can never be affected by Difficulty.

name: Habagat Oscillatory Shields
effect: At the start of the Monsoon's turn, if it is unable to attack any hostile characters with the Typhoon Flechette Launcher, it gains Resistance to all damage from attacks that originate within Range 5 until the end of the round. At the end of the Monsoon's turn, if it did not attack with the Typhoon Flechette Launcher, it automatically reloads that weapon.

name: Rain Shadow
trigger: A character within Sensors attacks an allied character within Range 5.
effect: The Monsoon hijacks the attacker's systems, forcing them to instead target the Monsoon, even if they normally could not. If the attack is part of an area of effect, the area must be repositioned to include the Monsoon, which may change its targets.

name: Guardian
effect: Adjacent allied characters can use the Monsoon for hard cover.

name: Sturdy Frame
effect: If the Monsoon is not Immobilized, when it is pushed, pulled, or knocked back, its movement is halved.

name: Kinetic Reservoir
effect: When the Monsoon makes an attack, it may expend any number of charges from this system to add the same amount of Knockback on hit. The Monsoon regains 2 charges each time it is hit by another character's ranged or melee attack.

name: Memetic Caltrops
effect: The Monsoon spreads paralytic memetics across a free Blast 1 area within Sensors. Hostile characters that start their turn at least partially within the area or move at least partially into it for the first time in a round take {2/3/4} AP energy damage and must pass a Systems save or become Impaired and Slowed until the end of their next turn. The area lasts until the Monsoon takes this action again or this system is destroyed.

name: Flood Targeting
effect: The Monsoon makes a tech attack against a character within Sensors. On a hit, until the start of the Monsoon's next turn, the target takes {2/3/4} AP energy damage each time they make an attack roll that does not target the Monsoon.

name: Galeforce Repulsor
effect: At the start of the Monsoon's turn, if it is unable to attack any hostile characters with the Typhoon Flechette Launcher, it may wreathe itself in a whirling energy field. While the field is active, when a ranged or melee attack hits the Monsoon, all damage is reduced to 0, and the field dissipates. All characters always know whether the field is active.

name: Hailstone Rounds
effect:
The Monsoon loads a special servo-crippling round. The next time it uses the Typhoon Flechette Launcher to Barrage, the Monsoon chooses one of the following on-hit effects:
  • Halt: Targets must make an Engineering save. On a failure, they become Immobilized until the end of their next turn; on a success, they become Slowed instead.
  • Disable: Targets must make a Systems save. On a failure, they become Jammed until the end of their next turn; on a success, they become Impaired instead.

name: Amihan Interdiction Routines [Veteran]
effect: Rain Shadow also triggers when a character within Sensors forces an allied character within Range 5 to make a save. If Rain Shadow is triggered in this way, the Monsoon makes the save instead and receives all effects.

name: Pathos Shotgun
effect: This weapon gains +1 Accuracy if the Paladin or an allied character within Range 3 is suffering from a hostile condition.

name: Interpose
trigger: A hostile character inflicts any number of conditions on an allied character within Range 5 of the Paladin.
effect: The Paladin may interrupt the triggering character, moving its Speed towards its ally by the most direct route possible. If the Paladin is adjacent to its ally before the triggering action or reaction resolves, it receives the conditions instead.

name: Pure Will
effect: When another character would inflict Jammed or Stunned on the Paladin, it may make a Hull save against them. On a success, the triggering character instead inflicts Impaired on the Paladin for the same duration they would have inflicted Jammed or Stunned.

name: Lean on Me
effect: As long as they are not Immobilized, the Paladin and adjacent allied characters cannot be moved involuntarily by characters smaller than the Paladin.

name: Fiery Rebuke
effect: After using Interpose, even if it can no longer take reactions, the Paladin may rebuke the triggering character. Until the end of the next round, they cannot use the action or reaction that triggered Interpose. Different Invade options are considered separate actions for this effect's purposes.

name: Indignation
effect: 1/round, the Paladin or an allied character within Range 3 may take a quick action or reaction that would normally be prevented by their hostile conditions. This trait cannot be used if it would cause the Paladin to exceed its Heat Cap.

name: Fortify
trigger: An allied character within line of sight and Range 5 is pushed, pulled, knocked back, or knocked Prone.
effect: The movement or status is prevented, and the triggering character gains Immunity to all the above effects until the start of their next turn.

name: Rallying Cry
effect: Until the end of its next turn, the Paladin exudes a Burst 3 aura. The Paladin and all allied characters within the aura count as Invisible against tech attacks and make saves against tech actions with +2 Accuracy. Each time a tech attack or tech action fails against an affected character, the attacker takes {2/3/4} AP energy damage and the Paladin takes 2 heat. The Paladin cannot take this action again until its effects end.

name: Share Burdens
effect: If the Paladin is not suffering any hostile conditions, it transfers one hostile condition from an allied character within Sensors to itself. The Paladin suffers the condition as if it had originally been inflicted on the Paladin, while the allied character instead becomes Impaired until the end of their next turn.

name: Lay on Hands [Veteran]
effect: When the Paladin Stabilizes, it may additionally clear one hostile condition from itself or an adjacent allied character.

name: Pavement Drone
effect:
Pavement Drone (Size 1/2, HP {1/1/1}, Evasion {10/10/10}, E-Defense {10/10/10}, Tags: Drone)
This drone can be attached to a free space or vertical surface within Range 5, where it covers a Burst 3 area with whitewash pavement. The pavement affects characters that are at least partially within the Burst 3 area and not flying. While on the pavement, the Pioneer and allied characters gain Immunity to the effects of Slowed, and whenever they begin movement on the pavement or move onto it, they gain +2 Speed until the end of the turn. Hostile characters that start their turn on the pavement or move onto it for the first time in a round must pass an Engineering save or become Slowed until the start of their next turn.
The Pioneer can deploy only one Pavement Drone at a time, but may redeploy an existing drone by taking this action again. The pavement lasts until the drone is redeployed or destroyed.

name: Reconnoiter
effect: The Pioneer surveys the battlefield, enabling up to two allied characters within Sensors to Boost as a reaction.

name: All-Terrain Treads
effect: The Pioneer ignores difficult terrain. When it makes an Engineering check against dangerous terrain or burn, it may take 2 heat to automatically succeed.

name: Expansionist
effect: The Pioneer may have up to two Pavement Drones deployed at a time, but each drone only affects a Burst 2 area. As a protocol, the Pioneer can move all Pavement Drones up to 3 spaces in any direction.

name: Sensor Relays
effect: When the Pioneer or an allied character uses a non-attack action or reaction, it may draw line of sight and measure distance starting from any Pavement Drone instead of itself.

name: Displacement Mine
effect: The Pioneer deploys a displacement mine in a free space within Range 3. The mine detonates in a Burst 1 area when an adjacent allied character triggers it as a free action or when a hostile character moves adjacent. Characters in the area are pushed 4 spaces in a direction of the Pioneer's choice, and hostile characters must additionally pass an Agility save or be knocked Prone. The Pioneer regains a charge of this system whenever a mine detonates.

name: Map-Territory Misalignment
effect: A hostile character within Sensors must pass a Systems save with +1 Difficulty or choose one: they only have line of sight within Range 3 until the end of their next turn, or they immediately move up to 4 spaces in a direction of the Pioneer's choice. This movement ignores engagement and does not provoke reactions.

name: Manifest Destiny
effect:
The Pioneer converts its intel into a decisive advantage. While this system is active, no other copy of it can be activated, and the following effects apply:
  • The Pioneer takes 4 heat at the end of each round before all other end-of-round effects.
  • While the Pioneer is adjacent to an Objective or in a Control Zone, hostile characters cannot Interact with, contest, or score that Objective or Control Zone.
This system remains active until the Pioneer deactivates it as a protocol, becomes Jammed, Stunned, or Exposed, breaks adjacency with an Objective, or leaves a Control Zone.

name: Breakfall Routines [Veteran]
effect: While affected by a Pavement Drone, the Pioneer and allied characters may stand up from Prone as a free action, climb at normal speed, and always ignore difficult terrain and dangerous terrain.

name: Sow
effect:
A character within Sensors must pass a Systems save or become Frightened.
Frightened characters make all attacks with +1 Difficulty, and when they take damage, the closest character allied to them that is within line of sight and Range 5 and not already Frightened must pass a Systems save or become Frightened.
Characters clear Frightened by passing a Systems save as a quick action or by damaging a Reaper.

name: Reap
effect:
The Reaper chooses one of the following effects. Regardless of line of sight, all Frightened characters within Sensors clear Frightened, then suffer the Reaper's chosen effect.
  • Fight: Targets take {2/3/4} burn, plus additional burn equal to the number of targets.
  • Flight: Targets move 5 spaces in directions of the Reaper's choice. This movement is involuntary but provokes reactions and engagement as normal and doesn't count as pushing or pulling.

name: Malaise
effect: Frightened characters within the Reaper's Sensors exude a Burst 3 aura. While they are at least partially within the aura, other hostile characters make all checks and saves with +1 Difficulty. The effects from overlapping auras stack.

name: Morbid Curiosity
effect: The Reaper spikes its weapons with hypnotic memetics. The next time the Reaper makes a successful ranged or melee attack, before it deals damage, all hostile characters within Range 5 of the target are pulled 3 spaces towards the target.

name: Blight
effect: The Reaper blights a free Blast 1 area within Sensors. Hostile characters that start their turn at least partially within the blighted area or move at least partially into it for the first time in a round become Frightened. If they are already Frightened, they take {2/3/4} burn. The area lasts until the Reaper takes this action again or this system is destroyed.

name: Overwhelming Presence
effect:
The Reaper gains two additional options for Reap:
  • Freeze: Targets are knocked Prone. If they are already Prone, they become Immobilized until the end of their next turn.
  • Fawn: Targets become Shredded and deal half damage, burn, and heat with attacks until the end of their next turn.

name: Cascading Fear
effect: The Reaper makes a tech attack against a Frightened character within Sensors. On a hit, the next time they take damage while Frightened, all of their allies within line of sight and Range 5 take {2/3/4} burn, then must pass a Systems save or become Frightened. As long as the target is Frightened, this effect refreshes at the start of each round.

name: Executioner [Veteran]
effect: 1/round, when the Reaper makes a successful attack with the Greywash Scythe, it may use that weapon to attack a different character within Threat, dealing half damage and burn.

name: Carnot Cycle
effect:
The Thermostat makes a tech attack against a character within Sensors, automatically hitting allies. On a hit, the Thermostat chooses one of the following:
  • Sap: The target clears {4/5/6} heat.
  • Overload: The target takes {1/2/3} heat immediately and a further 2 heat each time they take a quick action, full action, or reaction (even if taken as a free action) until the end of their next turn.

name: Second Law
effect: The Thermostat makes a tech attack against a character within Sensors, automatically hitting allies. On a hit, both the Thermostat and the target set their heat equal to half their current combined heat.

name: Heatsync
trigger: A character in line of sight and Sensors takes heat.
effect: The Thermostat takes the same amount of heat, then uses Carnot Cycle against the triggering character. This reaction cannot trigger on the Thermostat's turn.

name: Blackbody Barrier
effect: While the Thermostat is in the Danger Zone and not Exposed, it gains +1 Accuracy to all its tech attacks and Resistance to all damage and burn. Whenever this trait reduces damage, the Thermostat clears 2 heat.

name: Maxwell's Demon
trigger: A character within Sensors rolls an attack.
effect: The Thermostat increases or decreases the final roll by 2. A roll may not be modified more than once by Maxwell's Demon.

name: First Law
effect: The Thermostat links with an allied character within Sensors. While Blackbody Barrier is active, it grants its Resistance to the linked character instead of the Thermostat. The Thermostat can only link with one character at a time, but may terminate the link as a quick action.

name: Third Law
effect: The Thermostat makes a tech attack against a character within Sensors, gaining +1 Accuracy against targets in the Danger Zone. On a hit, they gain the Thermostat's Mark, preventing them from clearing any amount of heat by any means except overheating. Whenever the marked character ends their turn, they must pass a Systems check or take energy damage equal to their heat. Characters clear the Thermostat's Mark by passing a Systems save as a quick action or when the Thermostat marks a different character.

name: Thermal Shock
effect:
The Thermostat makes a tech attack against a character within Sensors. On a hit, they take 2 heat and must pass a Systems save or become Shredded until the end of their next turn; on a success, they become Impaired until the end of their next turn instead.
If the target is in the Danger Zone when they make this save, the Thermostat may take 4 heat to apply Exposed instead of Shredded.

name: Ultraviolet Catastrophe
effect: After the Thermostat takes damage for the first time each round, the character within line of sight and Sensors with the most heat must pass an Agility save or take burn equal to half the Thermostat's heat before it took damage. If multiple characters are tied, the Thermostat chooses one randomly.

name: Paracausal Coolant [Veteran]
effect: Heatsync also triggers when a character within Sensors clears any amount of heat, except by overheating. If Heatsync is triggered in this way, the Thermostat clears all heat instead of taking heat.

name: Lithodynamic Movement Suite
effect:
If the Tunneler is on solid ground, it goes underground, gaining soft cover and the ability to ignore all terrain, obstructions, and engagement and Boost as a free action 1/turn. While the Tunneler is underground, other characters ignore engagement with it. Otherwise, the Tunneler interacts with other characters and objects normally.
If underground, the Tunneler resurfaces in the nearest free space before leaving the ground, after resolving any attack, or as a free action. Neither going underground nor resurfacing count as movement.

name: Subterranean Networks
effect:
Borehole (HP {8/10/12}, Evasion {5/5/5}, E-Defense {5/5/5})
Immediately after the Tunneler goes underground or resurfaces, it may take 1 heat to create a borehole occupying the area it currently stands on. The borehole is Height 1/2, cannot be created overlapping objects or terrain, does not obstruct movement or line of sight, and cannot interact with flying characters.
1/turn, when standing completely inside a borehole, characters may teleport to any other borehole as a free action as long as they can stand completely inside the target borehole. This teleportation cannot be redirected.
When a borehole is destroyed, it collapses and deals {4/5/6} kinetic damage to all characters and objects within, as well as to all Tunnelers that are underground.

name: Borehead Ram
effect: If the Tunneler is underground, this weapon gains +1 Accuracy, and after the attack resolves, the Tunneler may create a borehole without taking heat.

name: Explosive Emergence
effect: 1/round, after the Tunneler resurfaces adjacent to a character, they must pass an Agility save or be pushed back 3 spaces and knocked Prone.

name: Earthrend
effect: The Tunneler creates a borehole where it stands, then goes underground and moves its Speed in a straight line without provoking reactions.

name: Burrow
trigger: The Tunneler is targeted by an attack while aboveground.
effect: Before the attack is rolled, the Tunneler goes underground and creates a borehole.

name: Underwatch
trigger: A hostile character begins movement adjacent to or moves adjacent to a borehole while the Tunneler is underground.
effect: The Tunneler interrupts the movement, teleporting to the borehole and attacking the triggering character with the Borehead Ram.

name: Sinkhole Carver
effect: This weapon can only be used if the Tunneler is underground. It can target spaces occupied by the Tunneler, but cannot target flying characters. If there are multiple targets, the Tunneler does not resurface until all attacks resolve.
on_hit: Target is pulled as close as possible to the Tunneler and must make a Hull save. On a failure, they become Immobilized until they are moved involuntarily or they pass a Hull save as a quick action.

name: Oversize Tunnels [Veteran]
effect: The Tunneler and allied characters count as standing inside a borehole as long as they are adjacent to it and not flying, and when standing inside a borehole, they additionally gain soft cover which may be used to Hide.

name: Murphy's Law
effect: When hostile characters within Burst 2 succeed on an attack, they must choose one: they take {3/4/5} explosive damage, or they reroll and keep the second result. This effect triggers only once per attack roll.

name: Einstein-Rosen Bridge
effect:
The gate is 1 space tall and has a black side and a red side, clearly indicated to all characters on the field. The gate acts as a normal piece of hard cover.
Whenever a character uses an ability that can target another character within line of sight and X spaces, if the gate is within their line of sight and X spaces, they can target any character within line of sight and X spaces of any other gate, as long as they and the target character are on the same color sides of their respective gates. For attacks, cover is determined from the gate within X spaces of the target. Reactions can also be triggered using the same rules.

name: Kinetic Shunt
effect: The displacement mine detonates in a Burst 1 area when an adjacent allied character triggers it as a free action or a hostile character moves adjacent. Characters in the area are pushed 4 spaces in a direction of the Pioneer's choice, and hostile characters must additionally pass an Agility save or be knocked Prone.

name: Whitewash Pavement
effect: The Pavement Drone continuously covers a Burst 3 area with whitewash pavement. The pavement affects characters that are at least partially within the Burst 3 area and not flying. While on the pavement, the Pioneer and allied characters gain Immunity to the effects of Slowed, and whenever they begin movement on the pavement or move onto it, they gain +2 Speed until the end of the turn. Hostile characters that start their turn on the pavement or move onto it for the first time in a round must pass an Engineering save or become Slowed until the start of their next turn.

name: Subterranean Networks
effect:
The borehole is Height 1/2, does not obstruct movement or line of sight, and cannot interact with flying characters.
1/turn, when standing completely inside the borehole, characters may teleport to any other borehole as a free action as long as they can stand completely inside the target borehole. This teleportation cannot be redirected.
When the borehole is destroyed, it collapses and deals {4/5/6} kinetic damage to all characters and objects within, as well as to all Tunnelers that are underground.
